summary: Local developer tool for visually inspecting rendered SAT math questions as HTML: serves a FastAPI web page on port 7890 that displays question content with SVG and HTML assets rendered server-side, allowing engineers to visually verify generated question output during development without deploying to a remote environment.

evidence.claim: GET / renders an HTMLResponse for viewing SAT math questions with SVG/HTML assets server-side
question-viewer serve CLI starts a local FastAPI server on port 7890 for viewing rendered questions

invariants.statement: The question-viewer is a local-only development tool, not part of the production deployment
The server runs on port 7890 by default

scenarios.name: inspect generated question
scenarios.given: A locally running question-viewer server and a generated question JSON
scenarios.when: GET / is opened in a browser
scenarios.then: The question is rendered as an HTML page with all SVG and HTML assets displayed

scenarios.name: start viewer server
scenarios.given: A development environment with question-viewer installed
scenarios.then: A FastAPI server starts on port 7890 ready to serve question HTML pages

rebuild_decisions.name: Viewer implementation approach
options: Standalone FastAPI app with server-side rendering (current)
Extend the main API browser with a question-preview route
rebuild_decisions.constraints_from_source: question-viewer is a separate component on its own port
